9.  PR is a 54-year-old man who recently underwent gastric bypass surgery. He presents to his 
surgeon 6 months post-operatively complaining of headaches, fatigue, and being cold all the 
time. Which of the following deficiencies is most likely associated with these symptoms in 
patients who have undergone gastric bypass surgery?
a. Vitamin C
b. Riboflavin
c. Zinc
d. Iron
10.  DD is a 3-year-old boy from Africa who is admitted to the hospital and diagnosed with 
kwashiorkor. Which of the following macronutrients is believed to be deficient in patients with 
kwashiorkor?
a. Protein
b. Carbohydrates
c. Fiber
d. Calories
